value.description:
A cluster of processing cores wired together into a subordinate persona that takes over housekeeping from the armor's main computer. Raises the computational load of the piece it is installed in, and uses none itself.

Can't be removed if the remaining modifications would no longer fit.

Fits body armor and helmets.

A human heart kept beating in a cradle of processing cores and wired into the armor's life support. If the wearer's head is destroyed, the second heart refuses their death: it keeps them alive at 50% consciousness, tends all of their wounds, dulls their pain and gives them a surge of speed. It can't replace a head, though. Unless the head is restored somehow, they die two days later, and bleeding out or any other fatal wound still kills them.

Works once. After that it is spent, and has to be removed and replaced with a new one.

Has no quality.

Fits body armor only.
